display_name: Customer Sentiment and Churn Prediction Agent

knowledge.name: Fixed synthetic customer snapshot
knowledge.detail: Bundled fictional customer, interaction, NPS, complaint, engagement, product, tenure, and segment records support review.

knowledge.name: Transparent decision rules
knowledge.detail: Packaged thresholds, weights, retention options, costs, illustrative success rates, and segment benchmarks drive deterministic output.

knowledge.name: Controls and review guidance
knowledge.detail: Uploaded instructions define evidence use, identifier handling, prohibited actions, response order, and authorized review gates.

intelligence_processing.name: Cross-channel sentiment aggregation
intelligence_processing.detail: Summarizes synthetic interaction sentiment, NPS, products, and complaint counts across branch, phone, chat, email, and mobile.

intelligence_processing.name: Heuristic churn-review prioritization
intelligence_processing.detail: Applies disclosed weighted indicators to rank human review; scores are heuristics and never predictions of individual outcomes.

intelligence_processing.name: Retention option preparation
intelligence_processing.detail: Assembles reviewable service-recovery and outreach options from fixed rules without contacting customers or making offers.

intelligence_processing.name: Segment benchmark comparison
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares synthetic segment NPS and product averages with fixed benchmarks to identify areas for human investigation.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio conversational experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Provides natural-language access through a validated Draft agent with four behaviors and two synthetic knowledge files.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs CustomerSentimentChurnAgent through local Brainstem chat and UI endpoints using bundled synthetic records.

clients_user_interface.name: Role-based evidence review
clients_user_interface.detail: Supports relationship managers, retention specialists, customer-success leads, and experience leaders with reviewable responses.

management_reporting.name: Customer Sentiment Dashboard
management_reporting.detail: Reports average NPS, interaction totals, sentiment distribution, and customer-level NPS, products, and complaints.

management_reporting.name: Churn Prediction Report
management_reporting.detail: Reports heuristic scores, evidence fields, review priority, and indicator weights without claiming that churn will occur.

management_reporting.name: Retention Action Recommendations
management_reporting.detail: Lists bounded options, illustrative cost and success-rate fields, and customer-specific suggestions for authorized review only.

management_reporting.name: Segment Analysis
management_reporting.detail: Reports fixed segment benchmarks and synthetic NPS and product averages to guide investigation, not automated action.

tools.name: Portable CustomerSentimentChurnAgent RAPP tool
tools.detail: Single-file BasicAgent exposes four deterministic operations with bundled synthetic data and no required credentials.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the four-behavior conversational package; validated agents remain Draft and require approval before publication.

tools.name: Dynamics 365 Customer Service or CRM
tools.detail: Approved production seam for customer-service context; no live connection is configured in the synthetic package.

tools.name: Approved interaction analytics
tools.detail: Potential read-only source for voice, chat, survey, and complaint signals; demonstrations use fixed synthetic evidence only.

tools.name: Power BI
tools.detail: Named reporting seam for segment trends; the current package does not connect to live dashboards or datasets.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams outreach review
tools.detail: Named collaboration seam for human review; no message, task, outreach, approval, or customer action is configured.

tools.name: Deployment-selected foundation model
tools.detail: The deployment environment supplies the model for natural-language routing and evidence-first response generation.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic-only evidence enforcement
supporting_features.detail: Forbids browsing, live retrieval, enrichment, substitution, or invention; missing identifiers are reported as absent.

supporting_features.name: Four deterministic operations
supporting_features.detail: Routes sentiment dashboard, churn prioritization, retention options, and segment analysis from natural-language intent.

supporting_features.name: Evidence-first response contract
supporting_features.detail: Separates synthetic evidence, observed sentiment, heuristic analysis, reviewable options, and the approval gate.

supporting_features.name: Human review and approval gates
supporting_features.detail: Authorized relationship, retention, or customer-success reviewers must assess every priority and proposed option.

supporting_features.name: No autonomous customer contact
supporting_features.detail: Prohibits outreach, messages, cases, tasks, fee changes, offers, approvals, transactions, and external record changes.

supporting_features.name: Locked demo and isolation validation
supporting_features.detail: Maintains four persona-language cases with required evidence anchors and records four passing strict-isolation captures.

supporting_features.name: Draft and publication control
supporting_features.detail: Keeps exported Copilot Studio agents unpublished and makes publication a separate administrator-approved step.
